# Repair cafe under a borrowed name

A partner offered to include the repair cafe in a city-wide campaign. Their poster promises all household repairs. We cannot meet that promise. Use our own small description even if fewer people attend. [[Repair ideas]]: a larger audience is a cost when it arrives with expectations our room and skills cannot support.
